title: Yehuda Katz - Why Rails is Hard (Railsberry 2012)
summary: Yehuda Katz's Railsberry 2012 talk on why Rails is hard to learn and use. He explains that the framework's many features reflect real complexity in web applications that newcomers do not yet see.
why: Recommended to people who call Rails bloated, as an argument that its size comes from features you eventually need.

quote.text: I've seen an interesting talk[1] by Yehuda Katz: "why rails is hard".
